name: ollama-free-coder
description: Code with a local Ollama LLM: inline completion, chat sidebar with @mentions and apply buttons, agent mode (read/write workspace via tools), explain/refactor/fix/tests/docstrings on selection.

ollamaCoder.endpoint.description: URL of the local Ollama server.

ollamaCoder.chatModel.description: Ollama model used for chat / code actions.

ollamaCoder.completionModel.description: Ollama model used for inline code completion (a base/FIM model is recommended).

ollamaCoder.completionDebounceMs.description: Delay before requesting an inline completion (ms).

ollamaCoder.maxCompletionTokens.description: Maximum tokens for an inline completion.

ollamaCoder.temperature.description: Sampling temperature for code actions and completions.

ollamaCoder.contextWindowChars.description: Max characters of file context sent to the model.

ollamaCoder.agentMaxSteps.description: Maximum number of tool-calling steps the agent may run per turn.

ollamaCoder.searchBackend.description: Backend for the agent's web_search tool. 'duckduckgo' is fully free, no key required. 'google' uses Custom Search JSON API (100 free queries/day) and requires googleApiKey + googleCseId.

ollamaCoder.googleApiKey.description: Optional Google API key for Custom Search JSON API. Get one at https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials. Free quota: 100 queries/day.

ollamaCoder.googleCseId.description: Optional Google Programmable Search Engine (CSE) id. Create one at https://programmablesearchengine.google.com/ and enable 'Search the entire web'.

ollamaCoder.useLlmRouter.description: Use a small LLM to classify the user's intent (default on as of v1.4.7). When the router fails or times out, the chat view falls back to the built-in regex pipeline so behaviour is never worse than the old default. See ARCHITECTURE.md §4.

ollamaCoder.shadowLlmRouter.description: Call the LLM router on every turn and surface its decision as a notice, but keep the regex pipeline authoritative. Useful for tuning the router prompt.

ollamaCoder.routerModel.description: Model to use for the LLM router. Empty falls back to ollamaCoder.completionModel — small fast models are best (e.g. qwen2.5-coder:1.5b-base).

ollamaCoder.enableRunCommand.description: Allow the agent to call the run_command tool. Each command still requires a per-invocation user confirmation. Off by default.

ollamaCoder.runCommandTimeoutMs.description: Maximum wall-clock time (ms) a single run_command invocation may take before it's killed.

ollamaCoder.enableMusic.description: Allow 'play music' requests (e.g. 'Play Radio Tapok from Amazon Music') to open a streaming service in your browser/app. The model only extracts the artist & service; the plugin opens the URL locally.

ollamaCoder.musicService.description: Default streaming service used when a 'play music' request doesn't name one. A service named in the request (e.g. '...from Spotify') always wins.
